title: Classification of Conformal Supersymmetric Deformations of Schwarzschild Spacetime via Super Poisson-Lie T-duality/Plurality
summary: This paper investigates conformal supersymmetric deformations of Schwarzschild spacetime through the framework of super Poisson-Lie T-duality/plurality. We first study super non-Abelian T-duality in $σ$-models featuring a Schwarzschild metric coupled to two fermionic fields. This is realized by describing the original four-dimensional geometry and its dual counterpart via semi-Abelian Drinfeld superdoubles generated by the Lie superalgebras $({\C}^3 +{\A})$, ${\C}^3 \oplus {\A}_{1,1}$ and $(2{ \A}_{1,1}+2{ \A})^0$, supplemented by two spectator fields.
